about: The project list for the Cloudflare site (cloudflare/README.md). One section per project, at /<id>/. A coder signs in with the name that keys their entry; handle names their work folder (work/<handle>/) and the commit author; repo is the one team repo they open. Masters are never read or saved through the site. Passwords live in Cloudflare (the PI's page, or the setting PASSWORD_<NAME>), never here. "welcome" and each project's "about" are the welcome page's starting text; the PI edits it on /admin/. This copy is an invented example: replace it with your own projects.

about.description: An invented review used to show how a project is listed.

intro.title: Review Coder
intro.text: The team workspace for our evidence reviews. Each review has its own space: reviewers sign in with the name and password they were given, and open only their own work.
